response.justification: Strong, long-tenured generalist engineer (15+ years) with staff-level titles, solid TypeScript/Node.js depth, distributed/high-throughput systems experience, and demonstrated mentoring and public-teaching ability — all relevant to a customer-facing staff role. However, the core requirement of 8+ years building production AI solutions is not met: AI-related work is limited to roughly one year of MCP code generators and agent tooling at re:cinq. There is no evidence of Python, vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM evaluation/observability pipelines, or multi-agent frameworks, and cloud exposure appears limited to AWS CDK. Worth a screening call given the MCP work and adaptability, but a substantial GenAI gap versus the bar.
strengths: 15+ years shipping across web, backend, embedded; staff-level scope and mentoring
Hands-on MCP/agentic tooling and developer frameworks at current role
Deep TypeScript/Node.js plus proven teaching, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: No 8 years of production AI/GenAI work; AI exposure is ~1 year
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
Python absent from skills; cloud experience shallow (AWS CDK only, no GCP/Azure)

key_factors.factor: Senior/staff engineering breadth and MCP agent tooling
